existingRelatedScope: 50 red-and-blue-state map illustrations plus the three ballot-related artworks listed here. These are not to be redrawn or counted again.
observations: Search results contain ballot-box icons, voting booths, people voting, I Voted stickers, Election Day lettering and school mock-election sets.
Future new compositions must avoid copying the existing isolated hand-to-ballot-box, party donkey or Donald Trump ballot scenes and abstract state-map series.
Keep people and messages nonpartisan, devices generic, ballots fictional without real candidate names or fabricated results. Actual image evidence required before metadata.
No legal voting instructions, deadlines, eligibility or jurisdiction-specific procedures will be inferred from an illustration.
